stem: The nurse _____ the patients every morning.
explanation_tr: Ozne 'The nurse' tekil ucuncu sahis oldugu icin fiil '-s' takisi alir. Present Simple'da he/she/it ile fiil sonuna -s/-es eklenir.
rule_tr: Present Simple: He/She/It + fiil-s/es
tip_tr: Every morning gibi rutin belirten zaman zarflari Present Simple isaret eder.
extra_example: The doctor visits the hospital every day. (Doktor her gun hastaneyi ziyaret eder.)

stem: The doctor _____ the patient right now.
explanation_tr: 'Right now' ifadesi su anda olan bir eylemi gosterir, bu yuzden Present Continuous (am/is/are + V-ing) kullanilir.
rule_tr: Present Continuous: am/is/are + fiil-ing (su anda olan eylemler)
tip_tr: 'Right now', 'at the moment', 'currently' gorursen Present Continuous dusun.
extra_example: The surgeon is operating on a patient at the moment. (Cerrah su anda bir hastaya ameliyat yapiyor.)

stem: The ambulance _____ at the hospital ten minutes ago.
explanation_tr: 'Ten minutes ago' gecmiste belirli bir zamani gosterir. Past Simple kullanilir. 'Arrive' duzensiz olmayan bir fiildir, -d eklenir.
rule_tr: Past Simple: fiil-ed (duzenli) veya 2. hal (duzensiz). 'Ago' Past Simple isaretcidir.
tip_tr: 'Ago', 'yesterday', 'last week' gibi ifadeler Past Simple gerektirir.
extra_example: The patient recovered from the surgery two weeks ago. (Hasta iki hafta once ameliyattan iyilesti.)

stem: You are visiting a friend in the hospital. A nurse tells you that visiting hours are over. What do you say?

options.text: I don't care, I'm staying here.
OK, thank you. I'll come back tomorrow during visiting hours.
Can you give me some medicine?
I want to speak to the director right now.

explanation_tr: Ziyaret saati bittiginde kibar bir sekilde kabul edip ertesi gun gelebileceginizi soylemek en uygun cevaptir.
rule_tr: Visiting hours = ziyaret saatleri. Hastanede kurallara uygun ve kibar davranmak onemlidir.
tip_tr: 'I'll come back tomorrow' = Yarin tekrar gelirim. Kibar kabul + plan ifade eder.
extra_example: Thank you for letting me know. I'll visit again in the morning. (Beni bilgilendirdiginiz icin tesekkurler. Sabah tekrar ziyarete gelirim.)

stem: She needs to see _____ eye doctor as soon as possible.
explanation_tr: 'Eye' kelimesi sesli harf sesiyle baslar (e sesi). Bu yuzden 'a' degil 'an' kullanilir. Hangi doktor oldugu belirtilmedigi icin 'the' degil 'an' uygundur.
rule_tr: Sesli harf sesiyle baslayan kelimelerin onune 'an', sessiz harf sesiyle baslayanlarin onune 'a' gelir.
tip_tr: Onemli olan yazilis degil, SESTIR. 'An hour' (h sessiz), 'a university' (yu sesi).
extra_example: He went to an emergency room. (Acil servise gitti.)

stem: I have a terrible headache. I need to take some _____.
explanation_tr: Bas agrisi (headache) icin agri kesici (painkiller) alinir. Bandage = bandaj, injection = igne, stitches = dikiş, syrup = surup.
rule_tr: Painkiller = agri kesici ilac. Headache, toothache gibi agrilar icin kullanilir.
tip_tr: Pain (agri) + killer (olduren) = agri kesici. Ingilizce bilesik kelimeleri parcalayarak ogrenebilirsin.
extra_example: The doctor prescribed painkillers for her back pain. (Doktor sirt agrisi icin agri kesici yazdi.)

stem: The patient complained of pain in his _____, so the doctor ordered a chest X-ray.
explanation_tr: Gogus rontgeni (chest X-ray) akcigerleri (lungs) kontrol etmek icin cekilir. Ankle = ayak bilegi, wrist = el bilegi, knee = diz, elbow = dirsek.
rule_tr: Lungs = akciger. Chest = gogus. Chest X-ray akcigerleri kontrol etmek icin yapilir.
tip_tr: Vucut bolumlerini organlarla eslestirerek ogren: chest-lungs, skull-brain, abdomen-stomach.
extra_example: Smoking damages your lungs seriously. (Sigara icmek akcigerlere ciddi zarar verir.)

stem: I _____ visit my grandmother in the hospital tomorrow.
explanation_tr: Onceden planlanmis gelecek eylemler icin 'be going to' yapisi kullanilir. Ozne 'I' oldugu icin 'am going to' dogrudur.
rule_tr: Be going to: I am / He is / They are + going to + fiil. Planlanmis gelecek icin kullanilir.
tip_tr: 'Be going to' ile 'will' arasindaki fark: plan varsa 'going to', anlik karar ise 'will'.
extra_example: She is going to have surgery next week. (Gelecek hafta ameliyat olacak.)

stem:
A: What seems to be the problem?
B: _____
A: Let me check your temperature first.

options.text: I'd like to make an appointment.
I've been feeling dizzy and I have a fever.
Can I have the bill, please?
I want to visit my friend here.

explanation_tr: Doktor 'Sorun ne?' diye soruyor, sonra 'Once atesine bakalim' diyor. Bu baglamda hastanin ates ve bas donmesinden sikayet etmesi mantikli.
rule_tr: Doktora gidince sikayetini soyle: 'I have a fever / headache / cough' gibi ifadeler kullan.
tip_tr: Doktor diyaloglarinda 'What seems to be the problem?' = 'Sikayetiniz nedir?' anlamindadir.
extra_example: A: What's wrong? B: I have a sore throat and a runny nose. (A: Ne var? B: Bogaz agrim ve burun akmam var.)

stem: _____ you pass me the water, please?
explanation_tr: Kibar bir istekte bulunmak icin 'Could you...?' yapisi kullanilir. 'Please' ile birlikte nazik bir talep ifade eder.
rule_tr: Kibar istek: Could you + fiil + please? (... yapabilir misiniz lutfen?)
tip_tr: 'Can you' da dogrudur ama 'Could you' daha resmi ve kibarca bir ifadedir.
extra_example: Could you open the window, please? (Pencereyi acabilir misiniz lutfen?)

stem: You are at a pharmacy. You have a prescription from your doctor and you want to get your medicine. What do you say to the pharmacist?

options.text: I'd like to return this medicine.
I'd like to fill this prescription, please.
Can I see the doctor now?
How much is the consultation fee?

explanation_tr: Eczanede recete ile ilac almak icin 'fill a prescription' (recete ile ilac hazirlatmak) ifadesi kullanilir.
rule_tr: Fill a prescription = receteyi ilaca donusturmek, yani eczanede ilac almak.
tip_tr: Pharmacy = eczane, pharmacist = eczaci, prescription = recete. Bu uc kelimeyi birlikte ezberle.
extra_example: The pharmacist filled my prescription in ten minutes. (Eczaci recetemi on dakikada hazirladi.)

stem: I _____ my medicine yet. I need to take it now.
explanation_tr: 'Yet' kelimesi Present Perfect ile kullanilir ve 'henuz' anlamina gelir. 'Have/has + not + V3' yapisi kullanilir. Take-took-taken.
rule_tr: Present Perfect olumsuz: have/has + not + V3. 'Yet' ile birlikte 'henuz yapmadim' anlaminda.
tip_tr: 'Yet' cumlede gorursen Present Perfect kullan. Yet olumsuz ve soru cumlelerinde gelir.
extra_example: She hasn't seen the doctor yet. (Henuz doktora gitmedi.)

stem:
A: Do you have anything for a sore throat?
B: _____
A: Yes, please. How often should I take them?

options.text: No, we don't sell medicine here.
Yes, these lozenges work very well. Would you like a box?
You need to see a dentist for that.
You should go to the hospital immediately.

explanation_tr: A bogaz agrisi icin bir sey soruyor, cevabinda 'Evet, lutfen' diyor ve ne siklikta alacagini soruyor. Demek ki B ilac onermis ve A kabul etmis.
rule_tr: Lozenge = pastil. Sore throat = bogaz agrisi. 'How often' = ne siklikta.
tip_tr: Eczanede kullanisli ifadeler: 'Do you have anything for...?' = '... icin bir seyiniz var mi?'
extra_example: A: Do you have anything for a cough? B: Try this cough syrup. (A: Oksuruk icin bir seyiniz var mi? B: Su oksuruk surubunu deneyin.)

stem:
A: Good morning. How can I help you?
B: _____
A: Sure. Dr. Smith is available on Thursday at 2 p.m.

options.text: I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Smith, please.
I need to cancel my appointment.

explanation_tr: Gorevli musaitlik bildiriyor, yani arayan randevu almak istiyor. 'Make an appointment' = randevu almak.
rule_tr: Make an appointment = randevu almak. Cancel an appointment = randevu iptal etmek.
tip_tr: Telefonda randevu alirken: 'I'd like to make an appointment with...' kalibini kullan.
extra_example: I'd like to make an appointment for a check-up. (Kontrol icin randevu almak istiyorum.)

stem: He has been sneezing and has a runny nose. He probably has a _____.
explanation_tr: Hapsirma (sneezing) ve burun akintisi (runny nose) soguk alginliginin (cold) tipik belirtileridir.
rule_tr: Have/catch a cold = soguk alginligi olmak/kapmak. Belirtileri: sneeze, runny nose, cough.
tip_tr: Cold = hem 'soguk' hem 'soguk alginligi' anlamina gelir. Baglamdan anla.
extra_example: She caught a cold after walking in the rain. (Yagmurda yurudukten sonra soguk alginligi kapti.)

stem: The patient _____ when the nurse came into the room.
explanation_tr: Gecmiste devam eden bir eylemi baska bir eylem bolerse, devam eden eylem Past Continuous, bolen eylem Past Simple olur. 'Was sleeping' devam eden eylem, 'came' bolen eylemdir.
rule_tr: Past Continuous (was/were + V-ing) + when + Past Simple: Devam eden eylemi baska bir eylem boler.
tip_tr: 'When' gorursen iki zaman birlikte mi kullanilmis kontrol et: biri devam, biri nokta.
extra_example: I was reading a book when the phone rang. (Telefon caldiginda kitap okuyordum.)

stem: Your friend suddenly falls down and cannot move his leg. You think it might be broken. What should you say when you call for help?

options.text: My friend needs a haircut urgently.
My friend has a headache. Can you send some aspirin?
I need an ambulance. My friend fell and I think his leg is broken.
Can I make an appointment for next week?
My friend is feeling a bit tired.

explanation_tr: Acil bir durumda ambulans cagirirken ne oldugunu acik ve net soylemelisin. 'I need an ambulance' + durum aciklamasi en dogru yaklasimdir.
rule_tr: Acil durumlarda: I need an ambulance + ne oldugunu acikla. Kisa ve net ol.
tip_tr: Acil durum kelimeleri: ambulance, emergency, broken, bleeding, unconscious.
extra_example: Please send an ambulance. There has been a car accident. (Lutfen ambulans gonderin. Trafik kazasi oldu.)

stem: She went to the dentist _____ she had a terrible toothache.
explanation_tr: Dis agrisi (toothache) dise gitmenin SEBEBIDIR. Sebep bildiren baglac 'because' (cunku) kullanilir.
rule_tr: Because = cunku (sebep bildirir). So = bu yuzden (sonuc bildirir).
tip_tr: Sonuc + because + sebep. Sebep + so + sonuc. Yonu karistirma.
extra_example: He stayed in bed because he had the flu. (Gribi oldugu icin yatakta kaldi.)

stem: You look very tired. You _____ get some rest.
explanation_tr: Tavsiye vermek icin 'should' kullanilir. 'You should get some rest' = biraz dinlenmelisin.
rule_tr: Should = -meli/-mali. Tavsiye ve oneri icin kullanilir.
tip_tr: 'Should' tavsiye, 'must' zorunluluk, 'can' yetenek/izin. Guc siralamasi: can < should < must.
extra_example: You should drink plenty of water when you are sick. (Hastayken bol su icmelisin.)

stem: After the accident, the injured man was taken to the _____ for immediate treatment.
explanation_tr: Kaza sonrasi acil tedavi icin 'emergency room' (acil servis) kullanilir. ER olarak kisaltilir.
rule_tr: Emergency room (ER) = acil servis. Immediate treatment = acil tedavi.
tip_tr: Hastane bolumleri: ER (acil), ICU (yogun bakim), ward (servis), OR (ameliyathane).
extra_example: The emergency room was full of patients after the earthquake. (Deprem sonrasi acil servis hastalarla doluydu.)

stem: The patient _____ for the doctor for over two hours now.
explanation_tr: 'For over two hours' surec bildirir ve 'now' ile devam ettigi anlasilir. Gecmiste baslayip hala devam eden eylem icin Present Perfect Continuous kullanilir.
rule_tr: Present Perfect Continuous: have/has + been + V-ing. Gecmiste baslayip su an devam eden surec icin.
tip_tr: 'For + sure' ve 'since + baslangic noktasi' Present Perfect (Continuous) isaretcisidir.
extra_example: She has been studying medicine for five years. (Bes yildir tip okuyor.)

stem: If you _____ your medicine regularly, you will recover faster.
explanation_tr: First Conditional'da 'if' cumleciginde Present Simple, ana cumlede 'will + fiil' kullanilir. Gercek/mumkun kosullar icin.
rule_tr: First Conditional: If + Present Simple, will + fiil. Gercekci/mumkun gelecek durumlar icin.
tip_tr: If cumleciginde ASLA 'will' kullanma. If + present, ... will + fiil.
extra_example: If you don't eat healthy food, you will get sick. (Saglikli beslenmezsen hastalanirsin.)

stem: Blood tests _____ in the laboratory every day.
explanation_tr: Kan testleri analiz eden degil, analiz EDILENdir. Pasif yapi gerekir. Present Simple Passive: am/is/are + V3.
rule_tr: Present Simple Passive: am/is/are + V3 (past participle). Ozne eylemi yapan degil, eylemin yapildigi kisimdir.
tip_tr: Ozne eylemi yapiyor mu yoksa eylem ozneye mi yapiliyor? Yapiliyorsa PASIF kullan.
extra_example: Patients are examined by doctors. (Hastalar doktorlar tarafindan muayene edilir.)

stem: You _____ wear a mask in the hospital. It's a strict rule.
explanation_tr: 'Strict rule' (kati kural) zorunluluk ifade eder. 'Must' guclu zorunluluk bildirir.
rule_tr: Must = -meli/-mali (guclu zorunluluk). Should = -meli (tavsiye). Might = -ebilir (olasilik).
tip_tr: Kural/yasa varsa 'must' veya 'have to' kullan. Kisisel tavsiye ise 'should'.
extra_example: Doctors must wash their hands before surgery. (Doktorlar ameliyat oncesi ellerini yikamak zorundadir.)

stem: You witness a car accident on the street. One person is lying on the ground and appears to be unconscious. What is the first thing you should do?

options.text: Move the injured person to the side of the road immediately.
Call the emergency services and describe the situation clearly.
Take a photo and post it on social media.
Drive away because it's not your problem.
Give the person water to drink.

explanation_tr: Kaza gordugunuzde ilk yapmaniz gereken acil servisi aramak ve durumu acikca anlatmaktir. Yarali kisiyi hareket ettirmek (A) omurga yaralanmasi riskinden dolayi tehlikelidir.
rule_tr: Acil durumda: 1) Call emergency services 2) Describe the situation 3) Follow their instructions.
tip_tr: Unconscious = bilincini kaybetmis. Emergency services = acil servis. Describe = tarif etmek.
extra_example: I called 112 and told them there was an accident with one injured person. (112'yi aradim ve bir yarali ile kaza oldugunu soyledim.)

stem:
A: I've been having chest pains for the past week.
B: _____
A: No, this is the first time I've seen a doctor about it.

options.text: Have you seen a specialist about this before?
What time would you like your appointment?
How much exercise do you get?

explanation_tr: Hastanin cevabi 'Hayir, bu konuda ilk kez doktora geliyorum' olduguna gore, doktorun sorusu 'Daha once bu konuda uzmana gittiniz mi?' olmali.
rule_tr: Diyalogda hem onceki hem sonraki cumleye bakarak mantiksal baglanti kur.
tip_tr: Diyalog sorularinda A'nin cevabina TERS bakarak B'nin ne sordugunu bul.
extra_example: A: Have you had this problem before? B: Yes, it started last year. (A: Bu sorunu daha once yasadiniz mi? B: Evet, gecen yil basladi.)

stem: By the time the ambulance arrived, the patient _____ consciousness.
explanation_tr: 'By the time + Past Simple' yapisi, daha once gerceklesen eylem icin Past Perfect (had + V3) gerektirir. Ambulans gelmeden ONCE hasta bilincini kaybetmisti.
rule_tr: Past Perfect: had + V3. Gecmiste iki olaydan DAHA ONCE olan icin kullanilir.
tip_tr: 'By the time', 'before', 'after' gibi ifadeler Past Perfect isaretcisidir.
extra_example: The doctor had already left when I arrived at the clinic. (Klinige vardigimda doktor coktan gitmisti.)

stem: The surgeon will _____ on the patient's knee tomorrow morning.
explanation_tr: Surgeon (cerrah) ameliyat yapar. 'Operate on' = ameliyat etmek. Prescribe = recete yazmak, diagnose = teshis koymak, inject = igne yapmak, examine = muayene etmek.
rule_tr: Operate on someone = birini ameliyat etmek. 'On' edatini unutma.
tip_tr: Surgeon operates, doctor examines, nurse cares — her saglik calisaninin fiilini ogren.
extra_example: The surgeon operated on three patients yesterday. (Cerrah dun uc hastayi ameliyat etti.)

stem: You have been coughing for a week and you also have a high fever. You go to the doctor. The doctor asks you to describe your symptoms. What is the most appropriate response?

options.text: I've been coughing for about a week and I have a high temperature.
I feel great, just a regular check-up.
I broke my arm last month.
I need a sick note for work, that's all.
I just came to visit a friend.

explanation_tr: Doktor belirti sordiginda mevcut sikayetlerini acikca ve detayli anlatmalisin. Bir haftadir oksuruk ve yuksek ates en dogru cevaptir.
rule_tr: Belirtileri anlatirken: I've been + V-ing + sure + and I have + belirti. Bu kalip hem sureyi hem mevcut durumu bildirir.
tip_tr: Doktora gidince Present Perfect Continuous ile surecin ne kadardir devam ettigini soyle.
extra_example: I've been having headaches for three days and I feel nauseous. (Uc gundur bas agrim var ve midem bulaniyor.)

stem: The injured soldier _____ to the military hospital by helicopter.
explanation_tr: Asker tasIYAN degil, tasINAN kisidir, bu yuzden pasif yapi kullanilir. Gecmiste olan bir olay oldugu icin Past Simple Passive: was/were + V3.
rule_tr: Past Simple Passive: was/were + V3. Gecmiste yapilan eylem ozneye uygulanmissa kullanilir.
tip_tr: 'By + yapan kisi/sey' pasif yapiyi dogrular. 'By helicopter' = helikopter ile (arac).
extra_example: The patient was treated by Dr. Johnson. (Hasta Dr. Johnson tarafindan tedavi edildi.)

stem: If I _____ a doctor, I would work in a rural area to help people.
explanation_tr: Second Conditional gercek olmayan/hayali durumlar icin kullanilir. If + Past Simple (were), would + fiil. 'If I were' resmi kullanımdir (I/he/she/it icin 'were').
rule_tr: Second Conditional: If + Past Simple, would + fiil. Hayali/gercek olmayan durumlar.
tip_tr: Second Conditional'da 'If I was' yerine 'If I were' kullanmak gramer olarak daha doğrudur.
extra_example: If she were here, she would know what to do. (Burada olsaydi, ne yapacagini bilirdi.)

stem: My grandfather has heart problems, so he regularly visits a _____.
explanation_tr: Kalp (heart) sorunlari icin kardiyolog (cardiologist) uzmandir. Dermatologist = cildiye, neurologist = noroloji, pediatrician = cocuk doktoru, orthopedist = ortopedist.
rule_tr: Cardiologist = kalp uzmani. Cardio- = kalp ile ilgili on ek.
tip_tr: On ekleri ogrenirsen uzmanliklari tahmin edebilirsin: cardio=kalp, neuro=sinir, derma=cilt, pedia=cocuk.
extra_example: The cardiologist recommended that he exercise more. (Kardiyolog daha fazla egzersiz yapmasini onerdi.)

stem:
A: I've gained a lot of weight recently and I'm worried about my health.
B: _____
A: You're right. I should start going to the gym.

options.text: You should eat more fast food.
Don't worry, weight doesn't matter at all.
Why don't you try exercising regularly and eating a balanced diet?
You need to see a dentist immediately.

explanation_tr: A kilo aldigindan ve sagligindan endiselendiginden bahsediyor. A'nin cevabi spor salonuna gitmeyi kabul etmesi. Yani B duzenli egzersiz ve dengeli beslenme onermis olmali.
rule_tr: Why don't you...? = Neden ... yapmiyorsun? Oneri/tavsiye vermenin kibar bir yolu.
tip_tr: 'Why don't you...?', 'How about...?', 'You should...' — uc farkli oneri yapisi.
extra_example: Why don't you see a nutritionist? (Neden bir diyetisyene gitmiyorsun?)

stem: The test results are not clear. The patient _____ need further examination.
explanation_tr: Sonuclar net degil, yani kesin bilgi yok. 'May' olasilik/belirsizlik ifade eder. 'Must' ve 'has to' kesinlik bildirir ki bu baglamda uygun degil.
rule_tr: May/Might = -ebilir (olasilik). Kesin degil ama mumkun olan durumlar icin kullanilir.
tip_tr: Kesinlik siralamasi: will (kesin) > must (neredeyse kesin) > may (olabilir) > might (belki).
extra_example: This medication may cause drowsiness. (Bu ilac uyusukluga neden olabilir.)

stem: You are a visitor at a hospital and you cannot find the Intensive Care Unit. You see a hospital staff member. What do you say?

options.text: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the ICU, please?
Where do you keep the medicine?
I want to complain about the food here.
Can I park my car here?
What time does the cafeteria close?

explanation_tr: Yogun bakim unitesini (ICU) ariyorsan, personelden kibar bir sekilde yol sormalisin. 'Excuse me, could you tell me...?' kibar soru kalıbidir.
rule_tr: Yol sorarken: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to...? En kibar ve yaygın kalıp.
tip_tr: ICU = Intensive Care Unit = Yogun Bakim Unitesi. Hastane kisaltmalarini ogren.
extra_example: Excuse me, could you tell me where the radiology department is? (Afedersiniz, radyoloji bolumunun nerede oldugunu soyleyebilir misiniz?)

stem: This time next week, the surgeon _____ the complex heart operation.
explanation_tr: 'This time next week' gelecekte belirli bir anda devam edecek bir eylemi isaret eder. Future Continuous kullanilir.
rule_tr: Future Continuous: will be + V-ing. Gelecekte belirli bir anda devam edecek eylemler icin.
tip_tr: 'This time tomorrow/next week' gibi ifadeler Future Continuous'un isaretcisidir.
extra_example: At 10 a.m. tomorrow, I will be having my MRI scan. (Yarin sabah 10'da MR cektiriyor olacagim.)

stem:
A: Hello, this is Mark. I'm calling to let you know I won't be able to come to work today.
B: _____
A: I've got a terrible stomach bug. I've been vomiting since last night.

options.text: That's great news! Enjoy your day off.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. What's wrong?
You need to submit your report by 5 p.m.
Can you come in for just a few hours?

explanation_tr: Mark hasta oldugunu soylediginde uygun cevap empati gostermek ve ne oldugunu sormaktir. A'nin sonraki cevabiyla mantiksal olarak baglanir.
rule_tr: Call in sick = hasta oldugu icin isi aramak. 'I'm sorry to hear that' = bunu duyduğuma uzuldum.
tip_tr: Isyerinde hasta oldugunu bildirirken: 'I won't be able to come in today because...' kalibi kullanilir.
extra_example: A: I'm not feeling well, I need to take a sick day. B: Of course, take care of yourself. (A: Kendimi iyi hissetmiyorum, hasta izni almam lazim. B: Tabii ki, kendine iyi bak.)

stem: Diabetes is a _____ disease, which means patients need lifelong treatment.
explanation_tr: Diyabet omur boyu tedavi gerektiren bir hastaliktir. 'Chronic' (kronik) = uzun sureli, surekli. Contagious = bulasici, acute = akut/ani baslayan, temporary = gecici.
rule_tr: Chronic = kronik, uzun sureli. Acute = akut, ani baslayan. Contagious = bulasici.
tip_tr: Kronik (chronic) vs akut (acute): Diyabet kronik, grip akut bir hastaliktir.
extra_example: Asthma is a chronic condition that affects breathing. (Astim solunumu etkileyen kronik bir rahatsizliktir.)

stem:
A: Good afternoon. I'm here to see Dr. Yilmaz. I have an appointment at 3 p.m.
B: _____
A: Sure, here it is. My name is Ayse Kara.

options.text: I'm sorry, but Dr. Yilmaz is on holiday.
Could I see your ID and insurance card, please?
The doctor will call you tomorrow.
Please go directly to the operating room.
We don't have any appointments available.

explanation_tr: A kimligini ve ismini veriyor, bu da B'nin kimlik ve sigorta karti sordugunu gosteriyor. Hastane resepsiyonunda bu standart bir islemdir.
rule_tr: Resepsiyonda: 'Could I see your ID/insurance card?' = Kimliginizi/sigorta kartinizi gorebilir miyim?
tip_tr: Hastane resepsiyonunda istenecekler: ID (kimlik), insurance card (sigorta karti), appointment details (randevu bilgisi).
extra_example: Could I have your full name and date of birth, please? (Adinizi soyadinizi ve dogum tarihinizi alabilir miyim?)

stem: Your colleague at work looks pale and keeps coughing. You are worried about their health. What is the most appropriate thing to say?

options.text: You look terrible. You should go home.
You don't look well. Maybe you should see a doctor. I can cover your shift if you need to leave.
It's nothing serious, just ignore it.
You should take a vacation to Hawaii.

explanation_tr: Hem endiseni kibar bir sekilde ifade etmek hem de yardim teklif etmek en uygun yaklasimdir. B secenegi her ikisini de yapar.
rule_tr: Birisinin sagligiyla ilgili endise: 'You don't look well' + tavsiye + yardim teklifi.
tip_tr: Kibar endise ifadeleri: 'You don't look well', 'Are you feeling okay?', 'Is everything alright?'
extra_example: You don't look well. Why don't you take the rest of the day off? (Iyi gorunmuyorsun. Gunun geri kalanini izin alsan?)

stem: By the end of this year, the research team _____ the clinical trials for the new vaccine.
explanation_tr: 'By the end of this year' gelecekte belirli bir zamana KADAR tamamlanmis olacak bir eylemi gosterir. Future Perfect: will have + V3.
rule_tr: Future Perfect: will have + V3. Gelecekte belirli bir zamana kadar tamamlanmis olacak eylemler.
tip_tr: 'By + gelecek zaman' Future Perfect isaretcisidir. 'By 2027', 'by next month', 'by the time...'
extra_example: By next month, she will have recovered fully from the surgery. (Gelecek aya kadar ameliyattan tamamen iyilesmis olacak.)

stem: If the paramedics _____ sooner, the patient might have survived.
explanation_tr: Gecmiste gerceklesmemis bir durumdan bahsediliyor (paramedikler daha erken gelseydi). Third Conditional: If + Past Perfect, would/might have + V3.
rule_tr: Third Conditional: If + had + V3, would/might/could have + V3. Gecmiste degistirilemeyen hayali durumlar.
tip_tr: Third Conditional = gecmise pismanlik/varsayim. 'Keske ... olsaydi, ... olurdu.'
extra_example: If he had worn a seatbelt, he wouldn't have been injured. (Emniyet kemeri taksaydi yaralanmazdi.)

stem: This rare condition can only _____ by a highly specialised neurologist.
explanation_tr: Modal + passive yapisi: can + be + V3. Hastalik tedavi EDEN degil, tedavi EDILENdir, pasif yapi gerekir.
rule_tr: Modal Passive: can/must/should/may + be + V3. Modal fiillerle pasif yapiyi birlestirmek.
tip_tr: Modal + be + V3 kalibini ezberle. 'Can be done', 'must be taken', 'should be checked'.
extra_example: This infection must be treated with antibiotics immediately. (Bu enfeksiyon hemen antibiyotikle tedavi edilmelidir.)

stem: The patient can be discharged tomorrow _____ there are no complications overnight.
explanation_tr: Hasta taburcu edilebilir SART: gece komplikasyon olmamasi. 'Provided that' = -mesi sartiyla, kosulu ile.
rule_tr: Provided that / As long as = -mesi sartiyla. Bir kosul belirtir.
tip_tr: Provided that = as long as = on condition that. Uc farkli soyleyis, ayni anlam: '... sartiyla'.
extra_example: You can go home provided that you take your medication regularly. (Ilaclarini duzenli alman sartiyla eve gidebilirsin.)

stem: The patient's condition improved dramatically overnight. The new medication _____ worked.
explanation_tr: Hastanin durumu dramatik sekilde iyilesti. Kanita dayali guclu bir cikarim: ilac ise yaramis OLMALI. 'Must have + V3' gecmis hakkinda guclu cikarim ifade eder.
rule_tr: Must have + V3 = -mis olmali (gecmis hakkinda guclu cikarim/tahmin).
tip_tr: Must have done = kesin oyle olmustur. Can't have done = oyle olmasi imkansiz. Ikisi birbirinin zittidir.
extra_example: She must have forgotten her appointment. (Randevusunu unutmus olmali.)

stem: The pharmaceutical company conducted a double-blind _____ to test the efficacy of the new drug.
explanation_tr: Ilac sirketleri yeni ilaclarin etkinligini test etmek icin 'clinical trial' (klinik deneme/arastirma) yapar. 'Double-blind trial' = cift kor calisma.
rule_tr: Clinical trial = klinik deneme. Double-blind = ne hasta ne doktor kimin gercek ilac aldigini bilmez.
tip_tr: Trial = deneme/sinav. Court trial = mahkeme, clinical trial = klinik deneme. Baglama gore anlam degisir.
extra_example: The clinical trial showed promising results for cancer treatment. (Klinik deneme kanser tedavisi icin umut verici sonuclar gosterdi.)

stem:
A: We've reviewed your MRI results and I'm afraid the findings are concerning.
B: _____
A: There appears to be a small growth that we need to investigate further with a biopsy.

options.text: Can you explain exactly what you found?
I'd like to change my appointment to next week.
How much will the MRI cost?
I don't think I need any more tests.

explanation_tr: Doktor endise verici bulgular oldugunu soyluyor ve devaminda ne buldugunu acikliyor. Hastanin 'Tam olarak ne buldunuz?' diye sormasi en mantikli gecistir.
rule_tr: Kotu haber aldiginda detay sor: 'Can you explain...?', 'What does that mean?', 'What are the options?'
tip_tr: Tibbi diyaloglarda 'findings' = bulgular, 'concerning' = endise verici, 'biopsy' = biyopsi (doku ornegi alma).
extra_example: A: The results are abnormal. B: What does that mean for my treatment? (A: Sonuclar anormal. B: Bu tedavim icin ne anlama geliyor?)

stem: The World Health Organization announced that a new strain of the virus _____ in several countries.
explanation_tr: Ana cumle gecmis zamanda (announced). 'That' icindeki eylem duyurudan ONCE gerceklesmistir. Gecmisin gecmisi = Past Perfect. Virus tespit EDILEN seydir = Passive. Past Perfect Passive: had been + V3.
rule_tr: Past Perfect Passive: had been + V3. Reported speech'te gecmisin gecmisini pasif olarak ifade eder.
tip_tr: Reported speech'te zaman bir adim geriye kayar: Present Perfect -> Past Perfect.
extra_example: The doctor said the infection had been caused by bacteria. (Doktor enfeksiyonun bakteri kaynakli oldugunu soyledi.)

stem: Antibiotics are effective against bacterial infections, _____ they are completely useless against viruses.
explanation_tr: Antibiyotikler bakterilere karsi etkili AMA viruslere karsi etkisiz. Karsilastirmali zitlik var. 'Whereas' = oysa ki, -e karsin.
rule_tr: Whereas / While (baglac) = oysa ki. Iki seyi karsilastirarak zitligini gostermek icin kullanilir.
tip_tr: Whereas = dogrudan karsilastirma zitligi. However = genel zitlik. Whereas daha spesifik ve akademik.
extra_example: Surgery requires weeks of recovery, whereas medication works gradually. (Ameliyat haftalarca iyilesme gerektirirken, ilac tedavisi yavas yavas etki eder.)

stem: You are about to have surgery and the doctor asks you to sign a consent form. You don't fully understand the risks mentioned in the form. What should you do?

options.text: Sign the form immediately without reading it.
Refuse to have the surgery and leave the hospital.
Ask the doctor to explain the risks in detail before you sign anything.
Ask the nurse to sign it on your behalf.
Cross out the parts you don't understand and sign.

explanation_tr: Aydinlatilmis onam (informed consent) hastanin riskleri anlamasi gerektirir. Anlamadigin bir seyi imzalamadan once doktora detayli aciklama istemek en dogru yaklasimdir.
rule_tr: Informed consent = aydinlatilmis onam. Hasta riskleri tamamen anlamadan imza atmamalıdır.
tip_tr: Tibbi ortamda hakkin: her seyi sormak ve anlamadan imza atmamak. 'Could you explain this in simpler terms?'
extra_example: Before signing, I'd like you to explain what could go wrong during the procedure. (Imzalamadan once, islem sirasinda nelerin ters gidebilecegini aciklamanizi istiyorum.)

stem: She had her blood pressure _____ by the nurse before seeing the doctor.
explanation_tr: Causative 'have' yapisi: have + nesne + V3 (past participle). Birinin bir isi senin icin yapmasini ifade eder. Tansiyon olculdu = baskasi olctu.
rule_tr: Causative have: have + nesne + V3. Bir isi baskasina yaptirmak. 'I had my car repaired' = arabami tamir ettirdim.
tip_tr: Have something done = bir isi baskasina yaptirmak. Get something done da ayni anlama gelir.
extra_example: He had his teeth cleaned at the dentist. (Dislerini disce temizletti.)

stem: The patient was diagnosed with _____, a condition in which the body cannot regulate blood sugar levels properly.
explanation_tr: Kan sekeri (blood sugar) duzenleme bozuklugu = diyabet (diabetes). Arthritis = eklem iltihabı, pneumonia = zatürre, anemia = kansızlık, migraine = migren.
rule_tr: Diabetes = diyabet (seker hastaligi). Blood sugar = kan sekeri. Insulin = insülin.
tip_tr: Hastalik adlarini tanimlariyla birlikte ogrenirsen hem kelime hem tip bilgisi edinirsin.
extra_example: Type 2 diabetes can often be managed through diet and exercise. (Tip 2 diyabet genellikle diyet ve egzersizle yonetilebilir.)

stem: You _____ brought your X-rays. The hospital already has digital copies of everything.
explanation_tr: Hastane zaten dijital kopyalara sahip, yani rontgenleri getirmeye GEREK YOKTU (ama getirdin). 'Needn't have + V3' = gereksiz yere yapilmis eylem.
rule_tr: Needn't have + V3 = yapilmasina gerek yoktu ama yapildi. Gereksiz bir eylem.
tip_tr: Needn't have done = yapmana gerek yoktu (yaptin). Didn't need to = yapmana gerek yoktu (yapmadin).
extra_example: You needn't have waited for me. I could have taken a taxi. (Beni beklemene gerek yoktu. Taksi alabilirdim.)

stem: If he _____ smoking years ago, he wouldn't be in the hospital now with lung problems.
explanation_tr: Mixed Conditional: Gecmisteki bir eylem (yillar once birakmak) simdiki durumu (hastanede olmak) etkiliyor. If + Past Perfect, would + fiil (simdi).
rule_tr: Mixed Conditional: If + had + V3 (gecmis kosul), would + fiil (simdiki sonuc). Gecmis eylem -> simdi sonuc.
tip_tr: Mixed Conditional = If cumleciği 3rd, ana cumle 2nd. Gecmis sebep, simdi sonuc.
extra_example: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now. (Tip okusaydim simdi doktor olurdum.)

stem:
A: Doctor, what do the test results show?
B: _____
A: I understand. What are my treatment options?

options.text: Everything looks perfectly fine. You can go home now.
I'm afraid the results indicate that the tumour is malignant, but there are several treatment paths we can discuss.
I haven't looked at them yet. Come back next week.
You just need more rest and you'll be fine.
The lab lost your samples, so we need to redo the tests.

explanation_tr: Hastanin 'Tedavi seceneklerim nelerdir?' demesi, kotu bir haber aldigini gosteriyor. B secenegi hem kotu haberi verir hem tedavi yollari oldugundan bahseder.
rule_tr: Kotu haber verirken: 'I'm afraid...' ile basla, sonra tedavi seceneklerinden bahset.
tip_tr: Malignant = kotuhuylu (kanser), benign = iyihuylu. Tumour = tümör. Biopsy = biyopsi.
extra_example: I'm afraid the biopsy confirmed our concerns, but we caught it early. (Korkarim biyopsi endiselerimizi dogruladi, ama erken yakaladik.)

stem: The pandemic not only _____ the healthcare system but also exposed deep social inequalities.
explanation_tr: 'Not only ... but also' yapisinda her iki fiil ayni zamanda olmalidir. 'Exposed' Past Simple olduguna gore 'overwhelmed' da Past Simple olmali.
rule_tr: Not only ... but also: Iki fiil ayni zamanda (parallel structure). Ayrica devrik yapi da olabilir.
tip_tr: Not only A but also B = sadece A degil, ayni zamanda B de. Paralel yapi kuralinı unutma.
extra_example: The new drug not only reduced pain but also improved sleep quality. (Yeni ilac sadece agriyi azaltmakla kalmadi, uyku kalitesini de artirdi.)

stem: Your doctor recommends surgery for your back problem, but you are not sure if it's the best option. You want another doctor's opinion. What do you say to your doctor?

options.text: I don't trust you at all. I'm switching doctors.
Fine, let's do the surgery tomorrow.
I appreciate your recommendation, but I'd like to get a second opinion before making a decision.
I'll just look it up on the internet instead.
Surgery sounds fun, when can we start?

explanation_tr: Ikinci gorus (second opinion) almak tamamen hakkindir. Bunu kibar ve saygiyla ifade etmek onemlidir. C secenegi hem tesekkur eder hem de kibarca ikinci gorus istegini bildirir.
rule_tr: Second opinion = ikinci gorus. Hastanin en onemli haklarindan biridir. Kibar bir sekilde isteyin.
tip_tr: 'I'd like to get a second opinion' = ikinci bir gorus almak istiyorum. Bu tamamen normal ve hakkinizdir.
extra_example: I'd like to consult another specialist before proceeding with the treatment. (Tedaviye gecmeden once baska bir uzmanla gorusmek istiyorum.)

stem: The patient was connected to a _____ to monitor his heart rate and oxygen levels continuously.
explanation_tr: Kalp hizi (heart rate) ve oksijen seviyesini (oxygen levels) surekli izlemek icin 'cardiac monitor' kullanilir. Stethoscope = stetoskop, scalpel = bisturi, ventilator = solunum cihazi.
rule_tr: Cardiac monitor = kalp monitoru. Heart rate = kalp atim hizi. Oxygen level = oksijen seviyesi.
tip_tr: Tibbi cihazlari islevleriyle birlikte ogren: monitor = izleme, ventilator = solunum, defibrillator = kalp sok.
extra_example: The cardiac monitor showed an irregular heartbeat. (Kalp monitoru duzensiz kalp atimi gosterdi.)

stem:
A: You're being discharged today. Here are your post-operative care instructions.
B: _____
A: You should avoid heavy lifting for at least six weeks and come back for a follow-up in two weeks.

options.text: Thank you. Are there any specific activities I should avoid during recovery?
I don't need any instructions, I feel perfectly fine.
Can I have the hospital Wi-Fi password?
I'd like to stay another week, the food is great.

explanation_tr: Doktor agir kaldirmama ve kontrol tarihi konusunda talimat veriyor. Hastanin 'Kacinmam gereken spesifik aktiviteler var mi?' diye sormasi bu cevabi tetikler.
rule_tr: Taburcu olurken: post-operative care = ameliyat sonrasi bakim. Follow-up = kontrol randevusu.
tip_tr: Discharge = taburcu. Post-operative = ameliyat sonrasi. Follow-up appointment = kontrol randevusu.
extra_example: Please follow the post-operative instructions carefully to ensure proper healing. (Duzgun iyilesme icin ameliyat sonrasi talimatlari dikkatle takip edin.)

stem: You are a healthcare worker during a pandemic. A patient's family member is angry because they cannot visit the patient in the ICU due to strict infection control measures. How do you respond professionally?

options.text: I don't make the rules, talk to someone else.
Fine, you can go in, just don't tell anyone.
I completely understand your frustration. These restrictions are in place to protect both patients and visitors. I can arrange a video call so you can see your family member.
Visiting hours are over, please leave immediately.
Your family member is doing fine, there's no need to visit.

explanation_tr: Profesyonel yaklasim: empati goster, kurallarin nedenini acikla, alternatif cozum sun. C secenegi uc oggeyi de iceriyor: anlayis, aciklama ve cozum.
rule_tr: Zor durumda profesyonel iletisim: 1) Empati goster 2) Nedeni acikla 3) Alternatif cozum sun.
tip_tr: Saglik iletisiminde 'I understand your frustration/concern' = endise/hayal kiriligini anliyorum. Empatiyle basla.
extra_example: I understand this is difficult. We can update you regularly on your family member's condition. (Bunun zor oldugunu anliyorum. Yakinizin durumu hakkinda sizi duzenli olarak bilgilendirebiliriz.)
